name: APIVerveMACAddressLookup
summary: MAC Address Lookup validates any MAC address and converts it across standard colon, dash, dot, and raw hex formats.
description:
MAC Address Lookup validates any MAC address and converts it across standard colon, dash, dot, and raw hex formats. On paid plans it becomes a MAC vendor lookup API, adding the device hardware vendor and OUI identifier.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the MAC Address Lookup from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
